# learner

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:learner`](gmeow-learner.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/learner>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/learning`](../../slices/learning.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An agent receiving instruction in a [`gmeow:Teaching`](../classes/gmeow-Teaching.md) relation. NON-functional: several learners may be taught together in one [`Teaching`](../classes/gmeow-Teaching.md). Each learner's own acquisition is a [`gmeow:LearningEvent`](../classes/gmeow-LearningEvent.md) of variety [`gmeow:learningBeingTaught`](../individuals/gmeow-learningBeingTaught.md) participating in this [`Teaching`](../classes/gmeow-Teaching.md). Every learner must differ from the [`gmeow:teacher`](gmeow-teacher.md) (gmeow:TeachingShape).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Teaching`](../classes/gmeow-Teaching.md) -> [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:learner`](gmeow-learner.md) from [`gmeow:Teaching`](../classes/gmeow-Teaching.md) to [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

# --- The reified instruction: one teacher, TWO learners taught together, one
#     subject. teacher ≠ learner (gmeow:TeachingShape); co-taught learners share
#     ONE gmeow:Teaching rather than one Teaching each.
ex:lesson a gmeow:Teaching ;
    gmeow:teacher ex:mentor ;
    gmeow:learner ex:lillith, ex:rowan ;
    gmeow:subjectTaught ex:balancing ;
    rdfs:label "a group balancing lesson"@en .

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Teaching`](../classes/gmeow-Teaching.md), [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to bind a [`gmeow:Teaching`](../classes/gmeow-Teaching.md) to each [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) receiving instruction — non-functional, so a class taught together is one [`Teaching`](../classes/gmeow-Teaching.md) with several learners.

### Avoid when

- Avoid pointing it at the same agent as [`gmeow:teacher`](gmeow-teacher.md) (gmeow:TeachingShape forbids teacher = learner) and avoid splitting a co-taught group into one [`Teaching`](../classes/gmeow-Teaching.md) per learner when the instruction was joint; several learners share one [`Teaching`](../classes/gmeow-Teaching.md).

### How to use

- Bind each learning agent with [`gmeow:learner`](gmeow-learner.md), pair each with its own [`gmeow:LearningEvent`](../classes/gmeow-LearningEvent.md) (variety [`gmeow:learningBeingTaught`](../individuals/gmeow-learningBeingTaught.md)), and keep every learner distinct from the [`gmeow:teacher`](gmeow-teacher.md).

### Examples

- ex:lesson1 [`gmeow:learner`](gmeow-learner.md) ex:lillith.
